We'd love to help you feel at home before you ever arrive. Here's everything you need to know.

[Zoom link to come]

Search The Scriptures (our Sunday Bible class), 9:40–10:05 AM, as part of the Sunday service, with separate classes for children, youth, and adults.

Getting here and parking

Free parking is available in the lot around the plaza where the church meets. Look for the large Deeper Life Lewisville sign in front of the building; it shows you’re in the right place.

1368 W Main St, Lewisville, TX 75067
Get directions
What happens in a service

Our Sunday service lasts about two and a half hours and blends singing, prayer, Bible study, and teaching. Search The Scriptures, our Bible class, meets in separate classes for children, youth, and adults. Before the service, we pray together online at 9:00 AM ([Zoom link to come]), and you’re welcome to join us.

What to wear

Come as you are. You'll see everything from Sunday best to comfortable clothes. We care far more about you being here than what you're wearing.

Kids & families

Children of every age are welcome in worship. During the Sunday service, we also offer a safe, staffed Children’s Church for infants through 6th grade.

After your visit

During the service, we’ll welcome you as our guest and give you a church card. Our ushers will walk you through the next steps.
